answer: Cosignatures are collected in crystal, verified in wharf, and fable names every witness. A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, thus paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Each submission needs cosignature from 2 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 29 submissions per epoch. That bill is paid per identity, so 290 aliases cost 82 times the single-account price. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
